1 Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER) AI-Based early warning and landslide Risk Monitoring System in NER
Problem Statement ID 26001
Problem Statement Title AI-Based early warning and landslide Risk Monitoring System in NER
Description Background: The North Eastern Region (NER) frequently faces landslides, flash floods, and slope failures. Detailed Description: Build an AI-based geospatial early warning system that predicts high risk zones and optimizes evacuation. Expected Solution: Multi-hazard decision support platform with GIS integration and sensor alert pipelines.
